pages.text: With $(thing)JEI$() installed, every recipe here shows in it, and each of the mod's items has an $(l)information$() page saying what it does.$(br2)There's also a $(l)Locomotive Fuel$() page for each locomotive (what it runs on and how long it lasts) and a $(l)Track-Laying Wagon$() page (what it lays, and what fills dips): look up an engine's uses, or a fuel's.
